subject: Fermi GRB 260726A: Global MASTER-Net observations report
submitter: Vladimir Lipunov at Moscow State U/Krylov Obs <lipunov@xray.sai.msu.ru>
body:

MASTER-SAAO robotic telescope  [1]  located in South Africa (South African Astronomical Observatory) started inspect of the Fermi GRB 260726A ( Fermi GBM team, GCN 45218) errorbox  3746 sec after notice time and 3782 sec after trigger time at 2026-07-27 00:47:51 UT, with upper limit up to  17.5 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 78 deg. The sun  altitude  is -59.0 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = -10 deg., longitude l = 127 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3444915
